  <bpmn:message id="Message_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Quote" name="Quote"/>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SalesOrder" name="Sales order process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_SalesOrder">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesSupport" name="Sales staff or customer support">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Inquiry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddressConcerns</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Interest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotInterested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GuideSelection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideQuote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_QuoteApproval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderConfirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Inquiry" name="Customer inquires about a product or service">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns and questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interest" name="Is the customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Interested</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotInterested" name="Customer is not interested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide product or service selection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Interested</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote" messageRef="Message_Quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_QuoteApproval" name="Customer approves quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Approval" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in the system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderConfirmed" name="Order successfully placed and confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_Interest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Interested" sourceRef="Gateway_Interest" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerIsInterested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="Not interested" sourceRef="Gateway_Interest" targetRef="End_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Event_QuoteApproval" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SalesOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Sales" name="Sales process" processRef="Process_SalesOrder"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" name="Quote" messageRef="Message_Quote" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Quote approval" messageRef="Message_Approval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_SalesOrder"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/sales-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Quote" name="Quote"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Approval" name="Quote approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SalesOrder" name="Sales order process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_SalesOrder">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesSupport" name="Sales staff or customer support">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Inquiry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InformationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddressConcerns</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InformationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Interest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GuideSelection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_InterestNotSpecified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesRepresentative" name="Sales representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideQuote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_QuoteApproval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ApprovalNotSpecified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderConfirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Inquiry" name="Customer inquires about a product or service">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_InformationSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InformationSplit" name="Address inquiry needs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_InformationSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Address</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns and questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Address</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Address_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InformationJoin" name="Inquiry needs addressed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Address_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_Interest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interest" name="Is the customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_Interest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Interested</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide product or service selection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Interested</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Selection_Quote</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote to customer" messageRef="Message_Quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Selection_Quote</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Quote_ApprovalEvent</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_QuoteApproval" name="Customer approves quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Quote_ApprovalEvent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Approval" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Proceed after customer approval?" default="Flow_ApprovalNotSpecified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApprovalNotSpecified</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Place_Record</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in the system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Place_Record</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Record_Confirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_Confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Record_Confirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirmation_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_InterestNotSpecified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ApprovalNotSpecified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApprovalNotSpecified</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderConfirmed" name="Order successfully placed and confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirmation_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_InformationSplit" sourceRef="Start_Inquiry" targetRef="Gateway_InformationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Collect" sourceRef="Gateway_InformationSplit" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Address" sourceRef="Gateway_InformationSplit" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Join" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Gateway_InformationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Address_Join" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_InformationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Interest" sourceRef="Gateway_InformationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_Interest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Interested" sourceRef="Gateway_Interest" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerIsInterested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" sourceRef="Gateway_Interest" targetRef="End_InterestNotSpecified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Selection_Quote" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Quote_ApprovalEvent" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_Gateway" sourceRef="Event_QuoteApproval" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerApprovedQuote</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApprovalNotSpecified" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="End_ApprovalNotSpecified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Place_Record" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_End" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SalesOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Sales" name="Sales process" processRef="Process_SalesOrder"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" name="Quote" messageRef="Message_Quote" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Quote approval" messageRef="Message_Approval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_SalesOrder"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/sales-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Quote" name="Quote"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Approval" name="Quote approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SalesOrder" name="Sales order process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Inquiry" name="Customer inquires about a product or service">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_InformationSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InformationSplit" name="Address inquiry needs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_InformationSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Address</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns and questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Address</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Address_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InformationJoin" name="Inquiry needs addressed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Address_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_Interest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interest" name="Is the customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_Interest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Interested</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide customer through product or service selection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Interested</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Selection_Quote</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote to customer" messageRef="Message_Quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Selection_Quote</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Quote_ApprovalEvent</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_QuoteApproval" name="Customer approves quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Quote_ApprovalEvent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_PlaceOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Approval" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_PlaceOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Place_Record</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in the system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Place_Record</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Record_Confirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_Confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Record_Confirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirmation_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_InterestNotSpecified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderConfirmed" name="Order successfully placed and confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirmation_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_InformationSplit" sourceRef="Start_Inquiry" targetRef="Gateway_InformationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Collect" sourceRef="Gateway_InformationSplit" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Address" sourceRef="Gateway_InformationSplit" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Join" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Gateway_InformationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Address_Join" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_InformationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Interest" sourceRef="Gateway_InformationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_Interest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Interested" sourceRef="Gateway_Interest" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerIsInterested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" sourceRef="Gateway_Interest" targetRef="End_InterestNotSpecified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Selection_Quote" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Quote_ApprovalEvent" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="Event_QuoteApproval" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Place_Record" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_End" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SalesOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Sales" name="Sales process" processRef="Process_SalesOrder"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" name="Quote" messageRef="Message_Quote" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Quote approval" messageRef="Message_Approval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
